content: When an SOS emergency is triggered nearby, registered Community Care Volunteers within a 1.5km radius receive dispatch notifications. Tap 'Accept Incident' to navigate directly to the patient's verified location.

Upon arriving at the scene: 1) Check responsiveness and breathing. 2) If non-responsive with no breathing, initiate chest compressions at 100-120 bpm (beat of 'Stayin Alive'). 3) Apply AED if available. 4) Position conscious fall victims carefully avoiding spinal rotation.
To log Proof of Care, scan the patient's verified QR code or confirm physical arrival in the Volunteer App. Log initial observation notes and transfer custody to arriving paramedics.
Ensure your personal safety before entering an unverified scene. If the incident is confirmed to be a false alarm or paramedics have taken over, mark the dispatch as 'Resolved - Paramedic Transfer'.
